mission: Given a landscape/environment and initial ancestry, autonomously grow an evolving ecosystem whose organisms, populations, niches, succession and later food webs emerge from causal rules and history; export portable ecology state that the world simulator can materialize and continue under the same ecological semantics without requiring a player.

layers.name: Simulator Living Ecology
layers.role: transfer ecology state into the world simulator and continue the same ecology at local/background resolutions

execution_modes.purpose: continue a planet/region without player presence at population/patch resolution
continue the same ecology in an active region with local detail and interaction

route: EVO2: long-run evolutionary landscape / succession / lineage divergence
EVO3: multi-trophic ecology / food web / coevolution
EVO4: autonomous regional/planet ecology runner with accelerated and background modes
XFER1: world-generation bridge after canonical simulator foundations
LIVE2: background/offscreen continuation and coarse/fine convergence

current_position.meaning: EVO0 hardening before first autonomous plant ecosystem proof

first_major_ecosystem_proof.goal: On a small deterministic heterogeneous landscape, a broad ancestral plant pool forms multiple persistent communities, succession and spatial structure without biome/species placement tables, with deterministic save/restart and explainable causal history.

world_generation_bridge.ownership_rule: ECO owns ecological occupancy/distribution semantics; G/MAT/ENV retain terrain, geology, substrate and environment truth ownership.

runtime_rule: An activated local patch is a higher-resolution continuation of the same ecology state, not a second ecology simulation.
background_rule: Ecology may continue without any player present.
presentation_rule: Mesh/asset/animation/LOD may change without changing ecological truth.
non_goals_now: production simulator integration before canonical shared foundations
one runtime entity per organism at planet scale
separate offline and runtime ecology truth models
